platforms.title: Platforms we program and integrate
platforms.intro: We choose the platform that fits your machine, your budget and the spare parts you can get in Egypt.

process.title: How we work
process.intro: Six steps from the first visit to a running machine. You talk to the same engineers throughout.

steps.title: Site visit and survey
steps.text: We see the machine or line, read the nameplates and drawings, and agree what the system must do.

steps.title: Proposal and design
steps.text: You receive a written scope and quote. Once agreed, we produce the schematics, I/O list and bill of materials.

steps.title: Build and program
steps.text: We assemble and wire the control panel, write the PLC program and design the HMI screens.

steps.title: Test before site
steps.text: Wiring checks, I/O simulation and an HMI walk-through before anything reaches your floor.

steps.title: Commission on site
steps.text: I/O and loop checks, interlock tests, start-up and tuning with your operators.

steps.title: Hand over and support
steps.text: As-built drawings, operator training and follow-up support when you need changes.

quoteChecklist.title: What we need to quote
quoteChecklist.intro: You do not need everything on this list. Send what you have and we will ask for the rest.
items: What the machine or line does, and what you want to change
Photos of the machine, the existing panel and the nameplates of the motors, drives and PLC
Drawings, an I/O list or the existing program, if you have them
Preferred PLC and HMI brand, or no preference
Supply voltage and frequency at the machine, for example 380 V, 50 Hz
Languages needed for the HMI screens and documents
quoteChecklist.whatsappHint: Easier on your phone? Send photos and drawings on WhatsApp.

default.title: Tell us about your machine or line
default.text: Send a short description and a few photos. An engineer will review it and reply with questions or a quote.

industry.title: Running a similar plant?
industry.text: Tell us which machine or process you want to automate, upgrade or fix. We work across Greater Cairo and Egypt's industrial zones.

project.title: Have a similar machine?
project.text: We can deliver the same scope for your machine or adapt it. Send us the details for a quote.

foreign.title: Involve a local automation team early
foreign.text: Send us your line list or machine documents and your schedule.

founderStrip.title: Engineers, not resellers
founderStrip.text: Mohammed Tarek Aboalsafa, our founder and automation engineer, has more than four years of experience designing, programming and commissioning PLC, HMI and SCADA systems for food and beverage, pharmaceutical and other plants.
